summary: The audit checks 45 units in courses numbered 100 and above: one letter-graded breadth course in each of the four areas, three letter-graded depth courses from one area (or a self-designed set of three MS&E graduate courses you move in), at least 36 letter-graded units, 27 of them in MS&E courses numbered 200 and above, and at most 3 units of MS&E 208 practical training. Checked by hand: the 3.0 GPA, the 2-unit minimum for the 27 MS&E units, at most four directed study units toward the letter-grade units, the 3-unit limit on other 1-unit courses, and multivariable calculus, linear algebra and programming, which you take in addition if you have not already. All 45 units must be taken at Stanford, apart from up to 18 non-degree units.
